name: PSC_VELZ_IMAX
reason: Upstream metadata bug: value 1000 matches ArduPilot's own code default POSCONTROL_VEL_Z_IMAX (AC_PosControl.cpp), but the upstream @Range says 1.000-8.000. The range annotation is stale, not the default. Re-check when rebasing onto a newer ArduPilot.

name: ATC_RAT_YAW_FLTE
reason: Accepted as-is for v1.0.1: 2.993685 Hz sits below the documented 5-50 Hz range, but it is a deliberate airframe value and is @READONLY so operators cannot change it. A lower yaw error-filter cutoff is reasonable on a heavy quad hovering at ~20 percent thrust. Kept knowingly rather than snapped to the documented minimum. Revisit if yaw tracking is ever investigated.
